Second, some failures arise from ambiguity in the specification, or from subtle mismatches between the intended design behavior and the behavior emphasized by the test cases.

Although the iterative debugging framework in ACE-RTL effectively improves code correctness, it may require a large number of iterations to converge when starting from an unfavorable initial RTL generation.
Although ACE-RTL achieves strong results on CVDP, it does not yet reach a 100% pass rate.

However, we intentionally exclude waveform information in this work to evaluate whether ACE-RTL can solve RTL tasks primarily through RTL knowledge acquired via domain-specific training and specification-grounded reasoning, using only limited non-waveform simulation feedback.
